scenario.title: Exceptional reviewed data repair
situations: A supported domain command cannot repair a bounded malformed record.
A human administrator receives a repair proposal with a simulation to review.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Guide was read; command availability and serving authority were not executed or proven.
Keep repair separate from schema migration, raw SQL write recipes, backups and ordinary setup.

lessons.title: Reach the explicit exception only after ordinary recovery
lessons.when: When a domain-specific recovery is unavailable and an authorized human administrator must review a bounded repair.
lessons.need: Learn the exact document, review, simulation and authority boundaries; an agent can explain the evidence but cannot assume its harness session may execute the repair.
lessons.surface: New public reviewed-operator-repair guide; registered operator command described there
lessons.gap: The current public guide describes operator.data_repair.run, but the supplied root-help capture has no operator namespace. Review question: is this a release/help-scope difference, and what shipped discovery/refusal should reach the guide?
